WITH channel_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_channel_avg
  FROM channel_averages
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT c.avg_feerate, c.avg_feerate - b.mean_channel_avg AS excess
  FROM channel_averages AS c
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE c.avg_feerate > b.mean_channel_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_above_benchmark_channel_avg,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: Channels with no non-NULL fee rates are excluded from the channel averages and benchmark because their average is undefined.
